chunks: Abu Ali Ahmad ibn Abi al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abduwayh al-Qattan narrated to us, saying: Abu Yazid Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Khalid ibn Yazid al-Marwazi at Ray in the month of Rabi' al-Awwal in the year 230 AH narrated to us, saying: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Hanzali narrated to us in the year 238 AH – and he is known as Ishaq ibn Rahwayh – saying: Yahya ibn ibn Yahya narrated to us, saying: Hashim narrated from Mujalid, from al-Sha'bi, from Masruq,

We were sitting with Abdullah ibn Mas'ood and presenting our copies of the Quran to him, when a young man asked him, 'Has your Prophet designated for you how many successors will be after him?' He replied, 'You are young, and this is something no one has asked me about before. Yes, our Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) designated for us that there will be twelve successors after him, equal in number to the chiefs of the Children of Israel.'

key_terms.صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ: Peace be upon them (used for Imams/Prophet)

ai.seo_question: How many successors did the Prophet designate according to the hadith of Abdullah ibn Mas'ood?
ai.summary: This narration from Abdullah ibn Mas'ood, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, establishes the number of Imams as twelve by drawing a parallel to the twelve chiefs (nuqaba') of the Children of Israel mentioned in the Quran. It serves as a critical hadith al-thaqalayn variant, affirming the divine appointment (nass) of the Twelve Imams and linking the continuity of prophetic leadership to the established structure of Israelite leadership.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 6-10 Abu Ali Ahmad ibn Abil Hassan ibn Ali ibn Abduwayh al-Qattan narrated that Abu Yazid Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Khalid ibn al-Marwazi at Ray in the (Arabic) month of Rabi’ul Awwal in the year 230 A.H. (844 A.D.) quoted on the authority of Ishaq ibn Yahya bin Khalid bin Yazid from Yahya bin Yahya Ibrahim al-Hanzalay known as Ishaq ibn Rahwayh in the year 238 A.H. (844 A.D.), on the authority of Haytham, on the authority of Mojalid, on the authority of al-Sha’bi, on the authority of Masrooq,

“We were sitting with Abdullah ibn Mas’ood and would read the Quran with him. A young fellow asked him asked, ‘Has your Prophet told you how man successors he will have after him?’ He replied, ‘You are young. No one had asked me this question before. Yes. Our Prophet (s) has told us that there will be twelve successors after him - as many as the Israelite chiefs.’”
